title: 第17章 善缘蓬莱道珍会第18章 射日神弓李玄霄误入断头局
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
九凤叹了口气，开门见山道：“道友见谅，方才我见你买下了一块箭簇残片，那是我好友后羿大巫的遗物，对我来说意义重大，但于道友而言，却无甚用处。”
“我想请道友割爱，将这残片转让于我。道友放心，我绝不会让道友吃亏，你想要多少元晶，或是想要天材地宝、功法秘术，只要我拿得出来，都可以谈。”
她的话很直白，也很客气，没有半分仗势欺人的意思，只是带着几分恳切。
她也看到了这箭簇残片，没想到晚了一步，被李玄霄先一步买走了。
李玄霄对此倒没有什么犹豫，心中瞬间有了决断。
这块射日箭残片，对他而言，确实是个可有可无的鸡肋，留着除了能当个纪念，没有半分用处。可对九凤、对巫族而言，这是挚友的遗物，是巫族大巫的荣光。
洪荒世上，广结善缘总归没有错。
更何况，他本就只花了十块下品元晶买下的残片，转手能结下一位顶尖大巫的善缘，这笔买卖，怎么算都值。
心念已定，李玄霄当即便取出那块箭簇残片递到九凤面前：“九凤大巫言重了！这残片既是后羿大巫之遗物，本就该物归原主，谈何割爱，更谈不上要什么元晶天材。”
九凤看着他递过来的残片，又看了看李玄霄坦然的目光，眼中闪过一丝诧异。
她活了无数岁月，见惯了洪荒之中为了一件宝物争得头破血流的修士，也做好了付出大代价换回残片的准备，却没想到，这个看起来平平无奇的截教小修士，竟如此爽快，甚至分文不取，直接就愿意把残片给她。
要知道，这虽是块残片，可毕竟是后羿射日箭的遗物，就算自己用不上，拿到坊市上，也有不少喜好收藏的修士愿意出高价收购。
而自己也摆明了自己的身份，自己可是巫族大巫九凤啊！
如今洪荒，巫妖对立，在巫族之中，十二祖巫在上，往下数来，除掉已经身死的夸父、后羿，也就轮到刑天、九凤了。
她不仅有着比肩大罗金仙境的剽悍战力，更手握九黎部族，大权在握。
诧异过后，九凤心中对李玄霄也生出了几分好感。
她本巫族，素来性格直率，且恩怨分明。
她接过残片，指尖抚过上面焦黑的纹路，眼中闪过一丝怀念与怅然，随即郑重地对着李玄霄拱手道：“多谢道友。这份人情，我九凤记下了。日后道友若是遇到什么难处，只要传讯到巫族九黎地界，我九凤必鼎力相助，绝无半分推辞。”
她说得斩钉截铁，没有半分虚言，巫族最重承诺，一言既出，便不会更改。
就这点来说，巫族做的的确比妖族、比人族，比那些大教弟子们做的都要好上太多。

李玄霄连忙回礼：“九凤大巫客气了，这不过是举手之劳，当不得如此。”
九凤摆了摆手，将残片收好，看着李玄霄，语气缓和了不少：“道友身具上清仙蕴，可是截教弟子？来这蓬莱坊市，是来淘宝的？”
“是，我乃截教弟子李玄霄，听闻这里有五百年一度的集会和那道珍会，特来看看，增长些见识。”李玄霄如实应答，没有隐瞒。
随后，李玄霄与九凤又寒暄了几句，便各自离去。
李玄霄一路问人这才到了那举办道珍会的会场。
不同于外围坊市的喧嚣热闹，道珍会附近人少了很多，守卫也森严了不少。
而李玄霄也是发现了一件奇怪的事情。
content_en:
Jiufeng sighed and said straight to the point: "Forgive me, fellow Taoist, but I just saw that you bought a fragment of an arrow cluster. It was a relic of my friend Hou Yi, the great witch. It is of great significance to me, but it is of little use to my fellow Taoist."
"I would like to ask fellow Taoist to part with me and transfer this fragment to me. Don't worry, fellow Taoist, I will never let you suffer any loss. As long as I can bring it to you, we can negotiate with you for as many yuan crystals as you want, or for the treasures of heaven, earth, earth, skills and secrets."
Her words were straightforward and polite. She didn't mean to bully others, but was sincere.
She also saw the fragments of the arrow cluster, but she didn't expect that she was a step too late and was bought by Li Xuanxiao first.
Li Xuanxiao had no hesitation about this, and instantly made a decision in his heart.
To him, this fragment of a sun-shooting arrow was indeed a dispensable piece of useless material. It had no use except as a souvenir. But for Jiufeng and the Wu Clan, this is a relic of a close friend and the glory of the great witch of the Wu Clan.
In this prehistoric world, there is nothing wrong with forming good relationships.
What's more, he only spent ten yuan of low-grade Yuanjing to buy the fragments, and he can resell them to form a good relationship with a top wizard. This transaction is worth every calculation.
Having made up his mind, Li Xuanxiao immediately took out the fragment of the arrow cluster and handed it to Jiu Feng: "Jiu Feng, the great witch, is serious! Since this fragment is a relic of Hou Yi, it should be returned to the original owner. There is no need to renounce love, let alone get any Yuanjing materials."
Jiufeng looked at the fragments he handed over, and then looked at Li Xuanxiao's calm eyes, with a trace of surprise in his eyes.
She had lived for countless years and was used to seeing monks fighting for a treasure in ancient times. She was also prepared to pay a high price in exchange for the fragments. However, she did not expect that this seemingly ordinary little cultivator would be so willing to give the fragments to her without taking any money.
You must know that although this is a fragment, it is a relic of Hou Yi's sun arrow after all. Even if he does not use it, if it is put on the market, there are many monks who like to collect it and are willing to buy it at a high price.
And he also made his identity clear, he is Jiufeng, the great witch of the witch clan!
Nowadays, in the ancient times, lich and demons are at odds. Among the witch clan, the twelve ancestor witches are at the top. Counting down, after excluding the dead Kuafu and Houyi, it is the turn of Xingtian and Jiufeng.
Not only does she have a fierce combat power comparable to that of Da Luo Jin Fairyland, but she also holds great power in the Jiuli tribe.
After being surprised, Jiufeng also felt a little fond of Li Xuanxiao.
She belongs to the witch clan and has always been straightforward and clear about grudges.
She took the fragment and ran her fingertips over the charred lines on it. A trace of nostalgia and sadness flashed in her eyes, and then she solemnly raised her hands to Li Xuanxiao and said, "Thank you, fellow Taoist. I, Jiu Feng, will remember this favor. If your fellow Taoist encounters any difficulties in the future, as long as the message is sent to Jiuli territory of the Wu clan, I, Jiu Feng, will do my best to help without any hesitation."
She said it categorically, without any lies. The Wu Clan made the most important promise, and once she said it, she would not change it.
In this regard, the Witch Clan is indeed doing much better than the Demon Clan, the Human Clan, and the disciples of those great religions.
Li Xuanxiao hurriedly returned the greeting: "Jiu Feng Great Witch is so polite. This is just a small effort and should not be treated like this."
Jiufeng waved his hand, put away the fragments, looked at Li Xuanxiao, and softened his tone a lot: "Fellow Taoist possesses the Qingxian Yun, but is he a disciple of Jie Jiao? Are you here in Penglaifang City to hunt for treasures?"
"Yes, I am Li Xuanxiao, a disciple of Jiejiao. I heard that there is a gathering here every five hundred years and the Daozhen Meeting. I came here to have a look and gain some knowledge." Li Xuanxiao answered truthfully and did not hide anything.
Afterwards, Li Xuanxiao and Jiufeng exchanged a few words and then left.
Li Xuanxiao asked people all the way before arriving at the venue where the Daozhen meeting was held.
Different from the hustle and bustle of the peripheral cities, there are far fewer people near Daozhenhui, and the guards are much tighter.
And Li Xuanxiao also discovered something strangethings.
